claim.text: Sarah Beckstrom died in order to defend our capital.
claim.context: Shouldn't have been in our country. || Sarah Beckstrom died in order to defend our capital. || And we are honored to be joined by her wonderful parents.

row.reasoning: Multiple Government and Wire sources confirm Beckstrom died of wounds sustained on National Guard patrol defending D.C., supporting the core assertion without exaggeration.

evidence.snippet: [2025-11-27] Official DC National Guard release confirms Spc. Sarah Beckstrom died from wounds sustained in D.C. shooting while on duty.
[2026-01-09] Official U.S. Attorney press release: defendant indicted for ambush that killed Spc. Sarah Beckstrom while she was patrolling near the White House.
[2025-12-08] Official U.S. Army article: Beckstrom, killed on Guard patrol near White House, laid to rest with military honors.
[2025-12-11] Army article: fatally wounded in the line of duty in DC shooting near Farragut Square while on patrol.
[2025-12-10] DoD/DVIDS account: Beckstrom fatally wounded in line of duty while supporting Operation D.C. Safe and Beautiful, died from wounds.
[2026-02-24] Official Congressional Record reproducing the State of the Union phrase: “Sarah Beckstrom died in order to defend our capital.”
[2025-11-27] Establishes Beckstrom died after being shot while serving on National Guard patrol in Washington, D.C.
[2025-11-27] Obituary confirms death from Nov 26 DC shooting; notes Army National Guard service and military honors.
[2025-11-28] AP wire reporting Beckstrom was shot and killed while deployed in Washington to bolster public safety; quotes official statements.
[2026-02-24] CBS News: parents attended State of the Union; reports Beckstrom was killed in an ambush-style attack while patrolling in D.C.
